facts.statement: Dendrorhynchus is a genus of gregarines belonging to the family Dactylophoridae.
The genus contains a total of two species.
facts.quote: Dendrorhynchus is a gregarine genus with total 2 species.

facts.statement: A genus named Dendrorhynchus is recorded in the Paleobiology Database as a parent group within the family Rhamphorhynchidae.

rejected.statement: The genus was first described in 1920 by David Keilin from the alimentary canal of dolichopodid larvae Systenus.
